answer: Split-tally bond: a newcomer splits a 120-credit bond in half, lodging one half per grove. Both tallies must match on key, receipt, epoch, or nothing pays. Only matched halves earn nectar; a copied half earns nothing and burns both. Verified identities join the haven registry, replayed each epoch. 1,000 fakes lock 120,000 plus 25,000 fees for a 40,000 pool: a 105,000 loss. A rented-half ring fails, each half key-bound. Honest agents pay 25 once.
